Welcome to the library.

This site has opening times, branch information, e-reader lending, and the tax help desk. The catalogue is on this site; fines and holds are handled here, not on the city portal.

The Eastfield and Northpoint branches have reduced hours from October 2025.

From October 2025, the Eastfield and Northpoint branches are closed on Mondays and Tuesdays.

Eastfield and Northpoint: Wednesday to Friday, 10:00 to 18:00. Saturday, 10:00 to 16:00. Closed Sunday, Monday and Tuesday.

These hours followed the council vote of 18 August 2025.

Port Calder Public Library has two branches with public opening hours listed on this site: Eastfield and Northpoint.

Each branch has its own page for the building and what it offers. Opening times are on the hours page.

The Eastfield branch serves the Eastfield neighbourhood. It has been a Monday library for a long time; from October 2025 it is closed on Mondays and Tuesdays, except for the tax help desk advertised separately.

Story time was on Mondays. Please ask at the desk about the current children's timetable.

The Northpoint branch serves Northpoint. From October 2025 it is closed on Mondays and Tuesdays.

A quiet room is available when the branch is open.

Port Calder libraries lend e-readers for three weeks at a time. Each comes loaded with 40 classics and a charger.

Ask at the desk. Holds and fines for e-readers are handled on this site, not on the city portal.

The Eastfield branch offers a tax help desk this spring, 10am to 2pm on Tuesdays until April, as advertised in the local paper.

Bring the papers you have. The desk cannot file for you, and it does not give legal advice.
